kultivator.dunia.pack.kampung: Kultivator: mortal villages and clan villages
kultivator.dunia.pack.kompleks: Kultivator: sect compounds behind the mountain gates
kultivator.kampung.desa.inspired: Inspired by Han Li's home mountain village at the start of A Record of a Mortal's Journey and the little shrine of the Earth God (Tudi Gong) found in nearly every Chinese village; game design.
kultivator.kampung.klan.inspired: Inspired by the Xiao family of Wu Tan City (Battle Through the Heavens) and the arrogant young master of a noble clan, a stock trope of xianxia novels; game design.
kultivator.kompleks_sekte.inspired: Inspired by the Seven Mysteries Sect of A Record of a Mortal's Journey and the Reliance Sect of I Shall Seal the Heavens: the outer disciples' court, the inner disciples' peak, the hall on the summit; game design.
kultivator.kampung.panen.mulai: The bell of %s rings three times: the Harvest Festival begins! The villagers leave the fields, beat the drums, and lay the common table on the square.
kultivator.kampung.panen.setia: %s gives thanks for your sect's protection: loyalty +%s.
kultivator.kampung.panen.jamuan.sedang: An old woman presses bread, baked potatoes and a slice of pumpkin pie into your hands: "Eat, guest. The harvest was good this year."
kultivator.kampung.panen.jamuan.salju: From the big cauldron by the bonfire a hunter ladles rabbit stew and carves mutton: "Warm your belly, guest. The winter is still long."
kultivator.kampung.panen.jamuan.sabana: The herders roast beef over acacia embers and split a melon: "Our herds grew fat this year. Take your share!"
kultivator.kampung.panen.jamuan.sakura: Under the cherry trees the village girls hand out grilled salmon, bread and petal-shaped biscuits: "For the guest who came with the blossoms."
kultivator.kampung.panen.jamuan.gurun: The village's caravan head offers spiced roast rabbit and melon cooled in the well: "Water and sweetness, the two greatest treasures of the sand."
kultivator.kampung.panen.jamuan.rawa: The marsh fishers share smoked cod and a bowl of red beetroot soup: "The marsh gives to the patient. Eat."
kultivator.kampung.panen.jamuan.teraseri: From the kitchen on the highest terrace the women bring down roast chicken, potatoes and pumpkin pie: "Every paddy step gives you one mouthful."
kultivator.kampung.panen.babak.0: The Rice Planting Dance: the farmers of %s dance in a ring around the bell, miming planting and reaping to the bamboo flute.
kultivator.kampung.panen.babak.1: Lion dance! Two youths of %s beneath a red lion head leap among the firecrackers; the children shriek with delight.
kultivator.kampung.panen.babak.2: The tug of war of %s: after three long pulls, %s win and are carried around the square.
kultivator.kampung.panen.babak.3: Dusk falls on %s. The villagers light paper lanterns and release them into the sky, one for every ancestor who keeps the fields.
kultivator.kampung.panen.tutup: The bell of %s rings once, softly. The Harvest Festival is over; the villagers go home with full bellies and light hearts.
kultivator.kampung.anak.datang.0: The head of %s comes leading a child by the hand: "Master, this child feels the wind before it blows. Take them to your sect." A candidate with a spiritual root waits at your hall.
kultivator.kampung.anak.datang.1: The head of %s bows: "The smith's child forges nails without burning, and the coals glow brighter when they breathe. We do not know what to do with them." The child now waits at your hall.
kultivator.kampung.anak.datang.2: A mother from %s weeps for joy: "Since they were small they dreamed of floating mountains. Yesterday they walked over the paddy water without getting wet. Take my child, master." A candidate waits at your hall.
kultivator.kampung.anak.datang.3: The head of %s arrives with a little shepherd: "Our herds have never strayed since this one kept them; even wolves keep away. Perhaps heaven has a plan for them." The child waits at your hall.
kultivator.kampung.anak.datang.4: The elder of %s hands over an orphan who has secretly practised breathing at the Earth God's shrine every dawn: "They copied your disciples who passed by. Let them learn from the real thing." The child waits at your hall.
kultivator.kampung.pasar.salam.0: A greengrocer waves: "Fresh from the fields this morning, guest!"
kultivator.kampung.pasar.salam.1: An old trader pats his basket: "Cheap, cheap! Village prices, not city prices."
kultivator.kampung.pasar.salam.2: Children run between the stalls; the smell of warm bread fills the air.
kultivator.kampung.pasar.habis: That ware is sold out today.
kultivator.kampung.pasar.jauh: There is no village market stall near you.
kultivator.kampung.klan.sikap: The clan's regard for you: %s (the pledge opens from %s, or after beating the Patriarch).
kultivator.kampung.klan.ikrar_terbuka: The clan is ready to pledge to your sect: place a Sect Patron Plaque near the clan's bell.
kultivator.kampung.klan.ikrar_tolak: %s refuses your plaque: "This clan does not bow to strangers." It needs regard %s (now %s) or a victory over the Patriarch.
kultivator.kampung.tuan_muda.judul: A Challenge on the Ground of %s
kultivator.kampung.tuan_muda.tantang: You. An outsider who walks our clan's ground as if he owned it. Draw your weapon, or kneel and admit defeat before everyone!
kultivator.kampung.tuan_muda.aturan: Sword Duel, friendly rules: stops at 10%%, no stake. The whole clan is watching.
kultivator.kampung.tuan_muda.terima.hove: Fight the Young Master before his clan
kultivator.kampung.tuan_muda.mengalah.ho: Admit defeat without a fight (the clan will look down on you)
kultivator.kampung.tuan_muda.ejek.0: Hmph. I can barely even smell your realm.
kultivator.kampung.tuan_muda.ejek.2: Look at that gait, like a lost farmer.
kultivator.kampung.tuan_muda.ejek.3: Our clan does not receive weak guests.
kultivator.kampung.tuan_muda.ejek.4: Your clothes are dusty. Is your sect too poor to buy a robe?
kultivator.kampung.tuan_muda.ejek.5: My father broke into a new realm at twenty. You? Still counting breaths?
kultivator.kampung.tuan_muda.ejek.6: Do not look at me like that. Even our servants carry more dignity.
kultivator.kampung.tuan_muda.ejek.7: Every arrogant guest in this village goes home with a bowed head. You are next.
kultivator.kampung.tuan_muda.tawa: Ha! I knew it. Go, and remember who made you kneel!
kultivator.kampung.tuan_muda.kalah: I-impossible... I... concede. Teach me that move one day.
kultivator.kampung.tuan_muda.menang: Hah! Just as I said. Go home and train another hundred years.
kultivator.kampung.tuan_muda.menang.chat: %s falls before his clan. Whispers spread; the clan's regard for you is now %s.
kultivator.kampung.tuan_muda.kalah.chat: %s lowers his sword with a satisfied smile. The clan cheers its young master.
kultivator.kampung.tuan_muda.mengalah.ch: You yield. %s laughs, and the whole clan laughs with him. Prices in this village are a little higher for you now.
kultivator.kampung.tuan_muda.tidak_ada: No challenge is waiting for your answer.
kultivator.kampung.patriark.undang.sedan: A guest as strong as you rarely stops at our small village. Sit, drink tea with me; these leaves were picked from the ancestors' garden.
kultivator.kampung.patriark.undang.salju: Sit by the stove, guest. This butter tea kept our ancestors alive through the longest winters.
kultivator.kampung.patriark.undang.saban: Our land is hard, but its guests are always welcome. Drink this milk tea stirred with acacia honey.
kultivator.kampung.patriark.undang.sakur: You came as the petals fall, a good omen. This cherry blossom tea is brewed only for honoured guests.
kultivator.kampung.patriark.undang.gurun: In the sand, water is dearer than gold. So this mint tea is the highest honour our clan can give. Drink.
kultivator.kampung.patriark.undang.rawa: The marsh mist hides many things, but not our hospitality. This lotus root tea calms the qi.
kultivator.kampung.patriark.undang.teras: These leaves grow on the highest terrace, where the clouds touch the earth. Our ancestors planted them three hundred years ago.
kultivator.kampung.patriark.teh: You drink tea with the Patriarch. Clan regard: %s.
kultivator.kampung.patriark.sapa.0: The clan's land is open to guests who know the customs. Honour our ancestors, and we honour you.
kultivator.kampung.patriark.sapa.1: The stones of this hall are older than any kingdom. Behave like a guest, and you will leave as a friend.
kultivator.kampung.patriark.sapa.2: A small clan survives by knowing friend from foe. I am still weighing which you are.
kultivator.kampung.patriark.hormat: My son fell before the whole clan and rose wiser. You are always welcome in this hall.
kultivator.kampung.patriark.remeh: Ah, the one who yielded to my son. Our tradition is hard on those who do not stand tall.
kultivator.kampung.patriark.tantang: Challenge the Patriarch for the pledge
kultivator.kampung.patriark.tantang.hove: Beat the Patriarch (%s) in a friendly Sword Duel: the clan will pledge to your sect
kultivator.kampung.patriark.terima: You want this clan? Then show that your sect is worthy of guarding and being guarded. On the ground, now.
kultivator.kampung.patriark.kalah: Your sword is honest. This clan will stand under your sect's banner. Hang your plaque by our bell.
kultivator.kampung.patriark.menang: Not yet. Come back when your sword is heavier than your words.
kultivator.kampung.patriark.menang.chat: The Patriarch bows deeply. %s is ready to pledge to your sect.
kultivator.kampung.patriark.kalah.chat: The Patriarch sheathes his sword. The clan's pledge is not open yet.
kultivator.kampung.patriark.jauh: The Patriarch is not near you.
kultivator.kampung.patriark.tidak_ada: The Patriarch cannot be disturbed right now.

kultivator.kampung.uji.klan: %s (style %s, %s blocks): Patriarch %s; your regard %s; patriarch beaten %s, young master beaten %s, yielded %s.
kultivator.kampung.uji.klan_tidak_ada: This world does not know any clan village yet.
kultivator.kampung.uji.lonceng_tidak_ada: No loaded village bell within 96 blocks.
kultivator.kampung.uji.bukan_ikrar: The nearest village is not pledged to your sect.
kultivator.kampung.uji.anak_gagal: No child could be sent (no hall, or the village record is missing).
kultivator.kampung.uji.daftar: Villages this world knows: %s hamlets, %s villages, %s market towns, %s clan villages.
kultivator.kompleks.sambut.sekutu.chat.l: The gate disciples of %s bow deeply: "Our seniors have been expecting you. The inner court and the summit are open to you."
The jade bell of %s chimes three times in welcome: "A friend of the sect has arrived! Prepare tea in the pavilion."
kultivator.kompleks.sambut.sekutu.chat.n: The guard of %s flicks his fan open and smiles: "An old friend! Our doors, and our friends' prices, are open to you."
The gate steward of %s writes your name in the golden guest book: "An honoured guest. The inner halls await you."
kultivator.kompleks.sambut.sekutu.chat.i: The masked guards of %s lower their spears: "Allies of our Master may pass. Everyone else feeds the poison garden."
The green torches at the gate of %s flare as you approach: "Your blood is known here, ally. Enter."
kultivator.kompleks.sambut.netral.chat.l: The guards of %s nod: "The front court is open to guests. The inner halls are for friends of the sect only."
A disciple of %s gives the fist-and-palm salute: "Guests of good intent may see the court. Mind your conduct."
kultivator.kompleks.sambut.netral.chat.n: The gatekeeper of %s weighs your robe at a glance: "The court and the market are open. Deeper than that, we talk price first."
The guard of %s leans on the gatepost: "Guests may look around. Do not touch what is not yours."
kultivator.kompleks.sambut.netral.chat.i: A disciple of %s whispers from the mist: "You may see this court. Beyond it... you are not useful enough yet."
The guard of %s sniffs the air: "The smell of an outsider. Stay in the court, and you might go home whole."
kultivator.kompleks.peringatan.chat.luru: The gate guards of %s draw their swords: "Leave. Our sect does not welcome enemies. To enter is to insult us."
The gate formation of %s hums and the disciples form a sword line: "In the name of the Master, step back."
kultivator.kompleks.peringatan.chat.netr: The gatekeeper of %s slams the guest book shut: "Your name is on the black list. Go, before the price is blood."
The guards of %s light a warning talisman: "One more step and we stop bargaining."
kultivator.kompleks.peringatan.chat.ibli: The masked guards of %s laugh hoarsely: "An enemy walks into the den alone? Come in, then. We are hungry."
Red mist creeps from the gate of %s: "Leave this place, or leave your life here."
kultivator.kompleks.dalam.peringatan.lur: An inner disciple of %s bars your way: "The inner halls are not for ordinary guests. Go back to the courtyard."
An elder of %s opens his eyes from meditation: "Young one, this path is for friends of the sect alone. Turn back."
kultivator.kompleks.dalam.peringatan.net: An inner disciple of %s spreads his arms: "The inner grounds need leave. Leave needs standing. You have neither yet."
The overseer of %s points at the notice board: "Guests stop at the court. Every breath here carries a fine."
kultivator.kompleks.dalam.peringatan.ibl: An inner disciple of %s steps out of the shadows: "You are lost. The lost here are rarely found again."
The snakes on the fence of %s hiss together: "Out of the inner grounds, outsider. Our Master hates to be disturbed."
kultivator.kompleks.masuk_musuh: You stepped into the court of %s without leave. Relations worsen: -%s.
kultivator.kompleks.dalam.denda: You linger in the inner halls of %s: relations -%s.
kultivator.kompleks.perang.chat: Horns sound across %s. Disciples and guards recognise the sect's enemy; the Master waits in the Summit Hall.
kultivator.kompleks.pasar.salam.lurus: The pavilion steward of %s straightens the pill bottles: "Honest medicine for honest guests."
kultivator.kompleks.pasar.salam.netral: The trader of %s opens his fan: "Talismans, maps, everything has its price, guest."
kultivator.kompleks.pasar.salam.iblis: A masked elder of %s smiles thinly: "Poisons and blood pills. Do not ask what for."
kultivator.kompleks.pasar.habis: That ware is sold out today.
kultivator.kompleks.pasar.jauh: There is no sect counter near you.
kultivator.kompleks.pasar.tolak: The trader of %s closes the stall in your face: "We do not trade with enemies."
kultivator.kompleks.pasar.dibeli: You bought %s for %s NB at the market of %s.
kultivator.kompleks.tanding.ajak.lurus: Friend of the sect! Our seniors say your sword is straight. Will you trade three moves with me?
kultivator.kompleks.tanding.ajak.netral: Honoured guest, our sect believes a sword speaks more honestly than a mouth. One round?
kultivator.kompleks.tanding.ajak.iblis: Ally of our Master... my blood boils at the sight of your blade. Spar until one of us kneels?
kultivator.kompleks.tanding.aturan: Friendly bout: stops at 10%%, no stake; sect relations +1 once a day.
kultivator.kompleks.tanding.terima.hover: A friendly Sword Duel with a sect disciple
kultivator.kompleks.tanding.jauh: There is no sect training ground near you.
kultivator.kompleks.tanding.bukan_sahaba: %s spars only with friends of the sect.
kultivator.kompleks.tanding.kosong: No disciple can spar with you right now.
kultivator.kompleks.tanding.menang: %s concedes with a bow. The disciples of %s applaud.
kultivator.kompleks.tanding.kalah: %s lowers the sword first: "Good moves. Again some other day." The disciples of %s nod with respect.
kultivator.kompleks.tanding.seri: The bout with %s ended without a winner.
